payload.name: Interpretive Time Parameter
payload.fact: The interpretive time parameter (p) is a conversion coefficient linking interpretive entropy to measurable economic cost in organizations.
payload.boundary: Used within the Interpretive Cost Model to translate interpretive load into measurable organisational resource consumption.
